newsitem.title: TURKEY: 19 dead in Turkish road crash.
newsitem.headline: 19 dead in Turkish road crash.

text.p: Nineteen people died in a road crash in eastern Turkey on Monday night when a coach and a truck collided, witnesses said.
Thirty-eight people were injured, five critically, in the accident 14 km (nine miles) from the town of Elazig.
Witnesses said the coach driver was trying to avoid hitting a tractor in front when the coach and a truck coming from the opposite direction collided head-on.
The coach was taking passengers from the eastern town of Mus to Istanbul.
Traffic accidents have killed 88,000 people in Turkey in the past 12 years.
